tests.name: pull request overview: what blocks it > lists a failed and a running build, and leaves the passed one to the quiet line
tests.why: only failing and running builds become blocker rows, the passed build goes to the summary line; title echoes the MUST's quiet-line wording

tests.name: pull request overview: what blocks it > lists nothing when nothing blocks, and sums up what passed in one line
tests.why: no blocker rows and a single passed summary when nothing blocks; title quotes the MUST's when-nothing-blocks wording

tests.name: pull request overview: what blocks it > lists merge conflicts, open threads with their one file, and a draft
tests.why: conflict, thread and draft blocker kinds with the Go to them next step

tests.name: reviewer photos > fetches only from the organisation's own Azure DevOps address, and refuses an id that is not a plain id
tests.why: photo fetch goes only to the configured organisation's host and rejects caller-shaped ids; title echoes the MUST's only-from-the-organisation wording

tests.name: reviewer photos > caps its cache by count, keeps a missing photo as missing, and writes nothing to disk
tests.why: in-memory cache capped by count and no file writes; title echoes the MUST's never-writes-to-disk wording

tests.name: pull request overview: what blocks it > marks nobody as you when the signed-in identity cannot be read
tests.why: the You match depends on the signed-in identity; required-once and initials fallback are only checked in the browser test

tests.name: Azure DevOps work items > reads a pull request in any project: blockers in fix order, reviewers, builds, open threads by file, size and linked work items
tests.why: linked work items were already read at base; test edited only for new reviewer fields; does not check the HTTP verb

tests.name: pull request overview: what blocks it > lists nothing when nothing blocks, and sums up what passed in one line
tests.why: also asserts the linked work item ids on the overview data

tests.name: opens an Azure DevOps pull request in a tab from Home and from ! in the palette, with what blocks it, its checks and its linked work items
tests.why: a linked work item opens AMC's work item tab

tests.name: when nothing blocks a pull request, the overview says so in one quiet line, shows each reviewer once with required on the reviewer, You for the signed-in person, initials when a photo fails, and work items last
tests.why: Raw switch shows every check including passed ones, every reviewer with raw vote and the branches

tests.name: opens an Azure DevOps pull request in a tab from Home and from ! in the palette, with what blocks it, its checks and its linked work items
tests.why: switches Raw and back to Insights; checks and activity under Raw

tests.name: when nothing blocks a pull request, the overview says so in one quiet line, shows each reviewer once with required on the reviewer, You for the signed-in person, initials when a photo fails, and work items last
tests.why: section order puts the description after status and reviewers

tests.name: a pull request opens on its sanitised description, lists its changed files with a read-only side-by-side diff, and shows its threads nested
tests.why: sanitised description still renders (tab name updated to Overview)

tests.name: pull request overview: what blocks it > names who rejected it and who waits for the author, each pointing at the comments
tests.why: made-up fixture per blocker kind in the fake Azure DevOps

tests.name: pull request overview: what blocks it > lists a rejected and a running policy, and skips the reviewer-count policy
the pull request overview lists a draft blocker: It is a draft
tests.why: one of the per-blocker browser tests with expectCleanLayout (title built by a template literal in a loop)

tests: tests/unit/ado.test.ts::Azure DevOps work items > reads a pull request in any project: blockers in fix order, reviewers, builds, open threads by file, size and linked work items
findings.note: work item details for the linked list come from a pre-existing read-only batch POST rather than the GET the MUST names; no mapped test asserts the request verb, and a test that did would fail on base and at head, so it would expose this (ruling rejected it as a literal reading)

tests: tests/e2e/app.spec.ts::the pull request overview lists a draft blocker: It is a draft
tests/unit/ado-overview.test.ts::reviewer photos > fetches only from the organisation's own Azure DevOps address, and refuses an id that is not a plain id
findings.note: test-focus finding: browser cases skip some implemented blocker kinds, and the photo tests call the client method instead of the HTTP route, so route-level auth and verb regressions go unchecked

notes: MUSTs 4 and 5 have only Playwright tests. Per-blocker browser tests are generated by a loop with a template-literal title; names are given as Vitest/Playwright would print them. ado.test.ts change for MUST 3 is an edit to an existing test, so on base it fails for the reviewer shape, not the work items. Review findings found in rv-pr-overview.jsonl.
